integrity: All formulas and hypotheses are stated with q an integer at least two; the original counting formula and the existence theorem for Steiner quadruple systems are credited. No independent scientific audit or external certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The numerical maximum follows from Chen–Ma–Zhang (2020); only the all-optimizer structural classification and its graph/Steiner consequences are claimed new. Classification of maximum quadruple packings and enumeration of all codes for arbitrary q remain separate challenges; finite tests are not proofs of the all-q statement.
title: The optimal four-multiset deletion codes as graph pairings over quadruple packings
